The 2015 comparison of Mars architectures [2] and the 2010 DRA 5.0 paper [5] have different information about DRA 5.0's crew size.

Source [2] (EMC, 2015, pages 16-17) says that DRA 5.0 specifies a crew size of six, all of whom descend to the surface for long-stay exploration.

Source [5] (DRA 5.0, 2010, pages 7-7) says that the rationale for a crew of six has been judged to be a reasonable compromise between the skill mix and level of effort for missions of this complexity and duration.

The sources differ.
